name: Spider Grenade
body:
Aura faint conjuration; CL 3rd; Slot —; Price 300 gp; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

This preserved spider, silver runes burned into its hairy legs and plump abdomen, barely fits in an adult human’s hand. It can be thrown up to 30 ft. as a grenade-like weapon. When the spider grenade hits a solid surface, it explodes into a sticky burst of fibrous webs, as the spell web, ensnaring everyone within a 20-ft. radius. These webs persist for 30 minutes before crumbling to dust.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, Spells web; Cost 150 gp
